messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Elevated 5xx and timeouts observed across streaming-gateway in us-west-2. Percent 5xx spike from baseline 0.4% -> 9.2% in last 3m. Paging eng-oncall. Link: https://internal.monitoring/redwood/streams
sam (eng-oncall): saw it, joining. +1 to triage channel. anyone oncall infra?
alex (eng-sre): I'm here. first look shows a surge of TCP resets and chunked-encoding errors from the gateway to backends, lots of 502 and 504s. stack traces mostly timeouts at proxy->modelsvc.
dina (prodops): customer-facing metric: streaming sessions dropped ~12% across a subset of clients. CS alerted. jamie can you confirm impact and top customers? :grimacing:
jamie (customer-success): yup — two customers on Dedicated reported user-facing disconnects, one with LLM chat sessions dropping. CS is sending an incident banner to affected customers now. will collate customer IDs.
kyle (api): quick telemetry: error headers show `upstream_reset` and `chunked_frame_truncation` fields. Gateway logs attached:
```
[ERR] 14:03:11 upstream reset: connection reset by peer id=gw-3
[ERR] 14:03:12 chunked: truncated frame, expected 1024 got 0 reqid=xyz
[WARN] 14:03:13 backend timeout after 10s route=/v1/stream
```
alex (eng-sre): interesting — backend timeouts cluster around a small set of hosts: modelsvc-pool-7a*, 7b*. Could be partial network flapping or CPU saturation due to a recent model rollout.
sam (eng-oncall): did we roll anything ~14:00? release bot?
alex (eng-sre): checking deploy history... `deploy-bot` shows a canary of quantized-v2 at 13:58 to modelsvc-pool-7a,7b — 5% traffic. That coincides with spike.
dina (prodops): can we revert the canary or shift traffic? We should also enable fallback routing to paged (non-streaming) for high-error customers as mitigation.
kyle (api): we can flip routing: `route-policy set streaming->fallback-paged if errors>5%` — I can apply a temporary rule to reduce streaming load. prepping command.
sam (eng-oncall): alex, can you drain modelsvc-pool-7a,7b from serving and route to healthy pools? perform graceful drain to avoid more resets.
alex (eng-sre): starting drain now. command:
```
./orchestrator drain modelsvc-pool-7a --grace 30s
./orchestrator drain modelsvc-pool-7b --grace 30s
```
alex (eng-sre): done — drain started. traffic shifting. watching metrics.
jamie (customer-success): pushing update to impacted customers: "We're investigating elevated streaming errors; we may temporarily switch to non-streaming fallback to preserve UX."
sam (eng-oncall): also toggled `streaming.keepalive=10s` on gateway to reduce half-open sockets. applied.
kyle (api): applied fallback routing rule to route 80% of new streaming sessions from affected customers to paged endpoints. config snippet:
```
- match: customer in [acct-12, acct-45]
  action: route_to paged_endpoint
  sample_rate: 0.8
```
alex (eng-sre): immediate drop in 5xx from 9.2% -> 3.5% in 90s. backend timeouts down. chunked truncation logs decreasing.
dina (prodops): good. jamie — customers ok with fallback?
jamie (customer-success): one customer asked for ETA; told them we're rolling back canary and will follow up in 30m. they prefer paged fallback temporarily.
sam (eng-oncall): schedule: I will continue handoff to night oncall in 20m. alex, please attach postmortem notes and logs to the thread. action items:
- alex: investigate why quantized-v2 canary caused truncation (possible incompatible streaming chunk boundaries) — due EOD
- kyle: add a safety gate on canaries that validates chunked streaming behavior in integration tests — due next sprint
- dina: coordinate rollback policy docs and runbook updates — due tomorrow
- jamie: list impacted customers and follow communications — ongoing
alex (eng-sre): noted. early hypothesis: kernel/buffer semantics changed in the new inference runtime causing early connection close under streaming, which manifests as chunked truncation client-side. reproducing locally.
sam (eng-oncall): leaving detailed monitoring alerts pinned. I'll mark the incident as mitigated once 5xx < 1% and customers confirmed. passing paging/handoff to alex for continued investigation.
alex (eng-sre): taking over oncall. will continue until cleared. ping me directly for escalation.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigation in place (drain + routing fallback). 5xx dropped to 2.8% in 5m window. severity lowered. Remember to run post-incident review.
jamie (customer-success): updated customer notes and created CS ticket with affected IDs. will send another brief when fully resolved.
sam (eng-oncall): thanks team. leaving notes: reproducible with `stream-test --model quantized-v2 --stream=true --payload-size=large` reproduces truncation locally. alex, attach failing logs to the ticket.
alex (eng-sre): attached logs + heap/profile. next step: revert canary or fix chunk writer. will update thread.
dina (prodops): closing live mitigation — toggles will remain for 1h then revert if stable. all right to shift to follow-up? :white_check_mark:
jamie (customer-success): yes. I'll schedule customer follow-ups.
sam (eng-oncall): incident handoff complete. moving to postmortem phase. :lock:"
